scenes.title:
A video from
a text file?
scenes.say: What if a short video started as a text file?

scenes.title: Four steps
scenes.say: You write a script. A voice reads it. Frames are drawn to match, and it all becomes one video.

scenes.title: What feeds what
scenes.say: The script and the brand file feed the voice and the frames, and those two make the video.

scenes.title: Two small files
scenes.say: You write the words to say, what to show, and your colours and fonts.

scenes.title: Start with one line

items.text: Can we explain the new feature in 30 seconds?
Yes. Send me the three main points.

scenes.say: Asked to explain something quickly? Ask for the main points first.

scenes.title: One project
scenes.name: Example project
scenes.say: Pick a format, a voice and your scenes, then render.

scenes.title: Pick the frame
scenes.say: Vertical suits phones and feeds. Landscape suits web pages and slides.

scenes.title: Keep text short
scenes.say: Keep on-screen text to a few words, and let the voice carry the detail.

scenes.title: A chart that grows
scenes.note: Placeholder numbers. Replace them with your own.
scenes.say: Option A, option B, option C. Each bar grows as it is named.

scenes.title: Code that types
scenes.say: Show a command, then its answer. The render line can be highlighted.

scenes.title: A timeline
scenes.say: Write the script, check the sheet, then render.

scenes.title: Paid services needed
scenes.label: paid services
scenes.note: voice, frames and encoding run on your machine
scenes.say: The number of paid services it needs is zero.

scenes.title: A quote card
scenes.text: Replace this with a real review.
scenes.author: Example only
scenes.say: Use the quote card for real reviews only.

scenes.title: Now write your own
scenes.say: Now open the script, and write your own.
